name: f3-missing-not-clean
alt: A report of seven passages with one missing. A report-only reader reads what the report holds, jumps over the gap without reading it and, right over the gap, says fine. probity-verify reads the report against the source capture, halts at the gap and returns contradicted: this passage is missing from the report, reason selected_span_missing_from_record.
words: this passage is missing from the report
